newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch -April 21.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch -April 21.

text.p: Following are views on the direction of Philippine stocks on Monday and main factors likely to affect trading.

* Philippine stocks are likely to move sideways in light trade on Monday due to a dearth of good news. "There's really not much incentive to buy at this point," said Erwin Balita, analyst at Dharmala Securities.
* Traders said there were no surprises in the first quarter company earnings announced so far.
* Investors are likely to ignore the Dow's rise Friday as prospects of a U.S. rate hike continue to cast a pall of gloom in the market, traders said.
* Dharmala Securities expects the Philippine composite index to find support at 2,850. It was up 17.11 points to 2,944.48 on Friday.
* The Dow Jones was up 44.95 points to 6,703.55 on Friday.
* The Philippine peso closed at 26.369 to the dollar on Friday from the previous 26.355.
* The interbank call loan average was unchanged at 10.03125 percent.
* Newspaper Businessworld reports that the Philippine Commission on Good Government wants San Miguel Corp to renegotiate for a better deal with Coca-Cola Amatil Ltd of Australia.
Newspaper Manila Times reports that the Board of Investments is finalising a proposal to impose a tax on a wide range of imported products to help local industries cope with trade liberalisation.
